dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D silhouette from the widest mid-body region toward the posterior extremity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel reflectance across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge extending along the central axis, creating a distinct shadow-casting elevation.

other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined, dark circular aperture (blowhole) visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
